title: app pages: a `record:related_list` or card list bound through `parentDataSource` receives the record page's related-list handlers, so authored toolbar and row actions draw instead of silently vanishing (ruling B on cloud#2774)
body:
Filed by the director seat (summon #43 continuation 4, `session_01QJC7i981TSs9L1CGJK59Ax`) on the maintainer's ruling Q2 B on objectstack-ai/cloud#2774 (batch #362 item 5, 「其他同意」; the ruling record is that card's `Ruled:` line) under the standing 口径 「平台相关的功能，应该尽量先改平台」. ⛔ Not a claim. Filing gate ①: a declared-but-not-honoured shape, measured by the cloud dev (cloud#2774 comment 6230709279) and spot-checked by the cloud seat.

## What is measured (objectui `origin/main` `1e6d83bc4895`)
- `packages/app-shell/src/views/pageRecordActions.ts:17`, `:41`, `:43`: an `app` page has no parent record, so its related lists resolve `NO_RELATED_HANDLERS`; `record-related-list.tsx:497`–`:506` hands authored `actions` down only when `onToolbarAction` / `onRowAction` handlers exist. Rows draw; the toolbar and row actions do not — and the spec admits the shape (`actions` on the block is legal), so an author's declaration is silently inert.
- Consumers: the control plane's members page (invite, change role, remove, resend / revoke — cloud#2912 Q1) and its environments page (打开 and a row menu on every environment — cloud#2916 / #2774 Q2), both ruled as custom `app` pages (cloud#2839 Q1 = D, 2026-10-13).

## Scope
1. On an `app` page, a `record:related_list` (and a card list) bound through `parentDataSource` receives the same related-list handlers the record page's bridge provides, resolved from the bound parent row: authored toolbar and row `actions` draw and run.
2. Where a handler cannot be served, the block says so loudly (a visible unavailable state), never a silent omission (ADR-0078).
3. `Clause-②: no` (renderer behaviour under declared keys; no new key).

## Done when
- A test: an `app` page with a `parentDataSource`-bound related list draws its authored toolbar and row actions and runs one; the record page is unchanged.
- cloud#2912 (the members page) and cloud#2916 / #2774 (the environments page) can start their pages.

Related: objectstack-ai/cloud#2774 (the ruling), #2912, #2916, #2839; objectui#12294 (the blocks bind per-element dataSources).
